summary: Super Micro Computer, Inc. filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a $1.25B common stock offering (price to be determined; June 9, 2026 close $40.64). Concurrently, it is offering 75M depositary shares representing mandatory convertible preferred stock and plans a $2B ATM program. No board recommendation or advisor named. Proceeds will fund component purchases to fulfill ~$39B in AI server orders and for general corporate purposes. Closings are not conditioned on each other. Watch for pricing, overallotment option exercise, and impact from the concurrent financings on stock price.
